validated_incident_persistence.test: Incident reaching RESOLVED with verified baseline return committed to database
validated_incident_persistence.evidence: Case inserted into SQLite table immune_cases; readable on subsequent cold query.

unvalidated_incident_rejection.test: Spurious or rejected incident (e.g. low-confidence, stale telemetry) must NOT be committed to memory
unvalidated_incident_rejection.evidence: Zero rows created in immune_memory_patterns for unvalidated incidents.

duplicate_pattern_consolidation.test: Repeated observation of existing pattern updates observedCount and lastSeen timestamp without duplicate primary key collisions

cold_restart_preservation.test: Database closed, application recreated, repository re-queried
cold_restart_preservation.evidence: All existing known patterns load into B-Cell antibody receptor cache immediately upon repository initialization.

corruption_defense.test: Malformed or null pattern code rejected with IllegalArgumentException; never stored in persistent memory
